aurorion_limbo.queda: You lost your last life. The Limbo took you in.
aurorion_limbo.queda.publico.nome: %s lost their last life and fell into the Limbo.
aurorion_limbo.vencido: Your time ran out. Nobody came.
aurorion_limbo.coleira: The Limbo will not let you go any further.
aurorion_limbo.porta.janela: The edges of the Limbo gave way. Walk.
aurorion_limbo.porta.saiu: You crossed alone. Nobody came for you.
aurorion_limbo.porta.saiu.repetido: You crossed alone again — %s times so far.
aurorion_limbo.ui.name: The Limbo
item.aurorion_limbo.vinculo_de_alma.desc: Use it on someone in the Limbo to bring them back.
item.aurorion_limbo.fio_da_volta.desc: Hold to pull the thread back to the exact spot of your last death. Single use; not dropped on death.
item.aurorion_limbo.relicario.desc: Calls back what your last death left on the ground and still exists. Single use; not dropped on death.
aurorion_limbo.oraculo.vazio.dica: There is nobody to bring back.
aurorion_limbo.oraculo.sem_vidas: You need %s lives to open the passage.
aurorion_limbo.oraculo.longe: You walked away from the Oracle.
aurorion_limbo.passagem.aberta: A passage opened for %s. It cost %s life.
aurorion_limbo.passagem.falhou: The passage refused the crossing. Tell the staff: the reason is in the server log.
aurorion_limbo.passagem.atravessou: You crossed. Find them and use the Bond.
aurorion_limbo.passagem.recusa.nao_exila: That person is no longer in the Limbo.
aurorion_limbo.passagem.recusa.voce_exil: You are in the Limbo. You cannot fetch anyone from here.
aurorion_limbo.passagem.recusa.sem_vidas: You do not have enough lives to pay for the passage.
aurorion_limbo.passagem.recusa.sem_espac: There is no room here for the passage to open.
aurorion_limbo.vinculo.usado: The bond closed. %s is coming back.
aurorion_limbo.vinculo.proprio: The Bond does not work on yourself.
aurorion_limbo.fio.usado: The thread pulled taut and brought you back to where you fell.
aurorion_limbo.fio.sem_chao: The thread finds no safe ground where you died.
aurorion_limbo.fio.barrado: Something bars the way to that world right now.
aurorion_limbo.relicario.chamando: The Reliquary calls for what you left behind...
aurorion_limbo.relicario.voltou: The Reliquary brought back %s stack(s) of items.
aurorion_limbo.relicario.vazio: Nothing from that death remains in the world. The Reliquary returned to you.
aurorion_limbo.espolio.sem_morte: There is no death of yours to return to.
aurorion_limbo.espolio.sem_mundo: The world where you died no longer exists.
